exposure: Embolization of aneurysm and choroidal feeders
outcome: Newborn care in neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Newborn started on breastfeed after mother's negative COVID-19 RT-PCR
cohort: A 29-year-old female, 34 weeks primigravida, who presented with a twice ruptured right choroidal artery arteriovenous malformation (AVM) and was COVID-19 positive.
finding: A multidisciplinary approach involving immediate external ventricular drain placement, emergency cesarean, and subsequent embolization successfully managed a ruptured choroidal artery AVM in a peripartum COVID-19 positive patient, leading to symptomatic improvement and stable residual AVM.
mod_finding: An emergency cesarean was performed as part of the immediate management strategy for the mother's critical condition, though no comparative finding on mode of birth is discussed.
